taskIdentity: Proposed local task identity; not a claim that a universal TaskRef contract is implemented.

scenes.title: Capture an outcome
scenes.caption: Capture is local-first. Main example creates T-084; Save for later starts nothing. Inputs and results are fictional design fixtures.

scenes.title: Saved task · needs analysis
scenes.caption: T-084 exists independently of a source, provider turn or workflow. Capture-only is a genuine non-executing path.

scenes.title: Analysis · a focused question
scenes.caption: The task stays T-084. One missing fact pauses the dependent calendar work; the policy permits useful investigation and drafting within scope.

scenes.title: A plan that can run
scenes.caption: These are durable proposed child tasks, not provider-native children started twice. The current policy permits automatic analysis/drafts; external actions remain outside it.

scenes.title: Delegated work in progress
scenes.caption: Assignments are fictional admission fixtures. A selected model does not move the workspace. Waiting children start only after their explicit dependencies are satisfied.

scenes.title: Needs your decision · observed attempts
scenes.caption: A stop request is not Stopped. The old attempt keeps its claim until acknowledgement or fencing. Choosing a meeting time does not authorize sending or scheduling.

scenes.title: Review the assembled outcome
scenes.caption: Preparation and observed worker completion precede this later review fixture. The optional external actions are reviewed here; no live connector or send is implemented.

scenes.title: Completed outcome · observed receipts
scenes.caption: All receipt IDs, times and outputs are fictional. Approval, confirmed action results and task completion are distinct milestones; this fixture illustrates the later observed result.

email.subject: Search refresh follow-up
email.body:
Hi Alex — the incident note says interrupted refreshes keep the last complete index. Please retry refresh and share the trace if it happens again.
Would Thursday 12 Nov at 2:30 pm PST work for a 30-minute follow-up?
Sources: Incident note.md §2; Customer email.eml.
